items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names and doc comments are mostly clear and follow the codebase style. ShapeIndex.decode is a long block with few comments, and it uses terse locals such as `n := d.readUvarint()` and `l := &LaxPolyline{}` in the decode logic.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: ShapeIndex.decode is about 150 lines, which exceeds the 100-line cap. Its per-tag switch cases repeat `if err := p.Decode(d.r)...`. The code went into shapeindex.go instead of the requested shapeindex_encode.go. The encode default path (`Encode(e.w)`) has no matching decode path.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Lengths are bounded before allocation and errors propagate through d.err. Edge IDs are never checked against shape.NumEdges(), and maxEdgesPerCell is not bounded. Loop and LaxLoop are unsupported, so encoding them errors. The hidden ByteCorruption and Truncated tests failed.

items.name: Existing encodings and Shape interface unchanged
items.name_zh: 既有编码格式与 Shape 接口不变
items.evidence: The new methods are additive. Existing typeTag values and per-shape wire formats are unchanged. The only edit to existing code is unexported: Polyline.decode now takes `*decoder` instead of `decoder`, with no format impact. The Shape interface is unchanged.
